description: This file implements variable tracking for PyTorch optimizers during Dynamo tracing, including handling optimizer state, parameter groups, static tensors for CUDA graphs, and finalization logic.

classes.name: OptimizerVariable
classes.description: A variable tracker for PyTorch optimizer instances that manages optimizer state, parameter groups, static tensors for CUDA graphs, and finalization.

methods.name: call_method
methods.description: Overrides method call to optimize optimizer initialization via _init_group.

methods.name: var_getattr
methods.description: Intercepts attribute access, especially for '_init_group' and 'param_groups'.

methods.name: graph_break_if_pending_mutation
methods.description: Checks for pending mutations on parameters to determine if a graph break is needed.

methods.name: _set_capturable
methods.description: Marks parameter groups as capturable if conditions are met.

methods.name: get_python_args
methods.description: Converts variable tracker args to their Python equivalents.

methods.name: move_step_if_cpu
methods.description: Moves optimizer step state to GPU if on CPU.

methods.name: map_sources_and_install_guards
methods.description: Maps tensor sources and installs guards for optimizer state and parameter groups.

methods.name: wrap_tensor
methods.description: Wraps a tensor in a variable tracker, marking static for CUDA graphs and creating weak references.

methods.name: update_list_args
methods.description: Updates args and kwargs for optimizer call with wrapped tensors.

methods.name: create_finalizer
methods.description: Creates a finalizer to clean up static tensor references when optimizer is garbage collected.
